It became the standard industrial white, used in paint, ink and rubber. As an artist's material it is cool and opaque but poor against acid. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 这一类「拿便宜的填料稀释贵的有效成分」的思路在颜料工业里非常普遍，代价往往是性能打折 —— 锌钡白遇酸会释放硫化氢，气味难闻，所以用它的漆不适合用在酸性环境里。
items.funEn: Diluting an expensive active ingredient with a cheap filler is a routine move in the pigment industry, and it usually costs performance: lithopone releases hydrogen sulfide on contact with acid, which smells appallingly and rules it out of acidic environments.

items.histZh: 马斯黄是人工合成的氧化铁黄，20 世纪初开始普及。它的思路是：既然天然土黄的颜色和稳定性都不错，那就干脆在工厂里把同样的成分做出来，颗粒更细、批次更稳定、杂质更少。马斯系列的黄、红、橙、黑都是这么来的。屏幕上的马斯黄是近似值。
items.histEn: Mars yellow is a manufactured iron oxide yellow, widely available from the early twentieth century. The reasoning was straightforward: since natural ochres are decent in both colour and stability, make the same compound in a factory with finer grain, steadier batches and fewer impurities. The whole Mars family of yellows, reds, oranges and blacks follows from that. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 马斯系列的名字来自「铁」的拉丁词根，跟火星共用同一个来源 —— 火星之所以是红的，也正是因为表面富含氧化铁。所以颜料商用一个行星给一整族铁系颜料命了名，倒是挺贴切。
items.funEn: The Mars family takes its name from the Latin root for iron, shared with the planet: Mars is red for the same reason, an iron oxide surface. A pigment manufacturer naming an entire iron-based family after a planet is, on the whole, accurate.

items.histZh: 马斯红是合成的氧化铁红，色相接近天然的红土系列，但纯度和一致性高得多。它的出现让画家不再依赖矿源 —— 原来同一句「威尼斯红」在不同年代买到的深浅可能差一档，合成之后这个问题基本消失。代价是颜色少了天然土那点不规则的活性。屏幕上的马斯红是近似值。
items.histEn: Mars red is a synthetic iron oxide red, close in hue to the natural earth reds but far higher in purity and consistency. It freed painters from dependence on particular deposits: a tube labelled Venetian red might previously have differed a step in depth from one decade to the next, and synthesis largely ended that. The cost is a certain irregular liveliness the natural earths had. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 合成颜料带来的「一致」其实有得有失。得的是可复制：今天调出的颜色，十年后还能调出一模一样的。失的是偶然性 —— 老画上那些因为土源不同而产生的微妙偏差，在现代配方里不会再出现了。
items.funEn: The consistency brought by synthesis cuts both ways. What is gained is reproducibility: a colour mixed today can be mixed again identically in ten years. What is lost is accident — the subtle deviations that arose from differing ore sources no longer happen, and a certain kind of variation has left painting altogether.

items.histZh: 铜蓝是用铜盐人工制造出来的碱式碳酸铜，色相比天然石青浅、偏青。它便宜、量大，是石青的廉价替代品，在室内装饰和廉价画作里用得很广。缺点是耐光性一般，见硫会变绿变黑。屏幕上的铜蓝是近似值，真颜料的颗粒感更明显。
items.histEn: Blue verditer is a basic copper carbonate made artificially from copper salts, lighter and more cyan than natural azurite. Cheap and available in quantity, it served as the budget substitute for azurite in interior decoration and inexpensive painting. Its weakness is moderate lightfastness and a tendency to go green and then black on contact with sulfur. The value shown is an approximation; the real pigment is visibly granular.
items.funZh: 铜蓝和铜锈其实是同一类化学物，只是制造方法不同：铜锈靠醋汽慢慢腐蚀铜片，铜蓝靠把铜盐溶液和碱混合后沉淀。同一族化合物，一个走「慢工」，一个走「快法」，出来的颗粒粗细差得很远。
items.funEn: Blue verditer and verdigris are chemically related, differing mainly in how they are made: verdigris by letting vinegar vapour corrode copper slowly, verditer by precipitating a copper salt with alkali. Two routes to the same family of compounds, one slow and one fast, and the resulting grain size differs considerably.

items.histZh: 锶黄是铬酸锶，属于铬酸盐颜料里较浅较亮的一支。它在工业上的主要用途跟锌黄类似 —— 防锈底漆，因为铬酸根有缓蚀作用。作为绘画颜料它偏冷、偏柠檬，着色力一般。屏幕上的锶黄是近似值。这类颜料的存在提醒我们：颜料史上的许多颜色，最初都是被工业需求推出来的。
items.histEn: Strontium yellow is strontium chromate, one of the lighter and brighter members of the chromate family. Its principal industrial use mirrors zinc yellow's: anti-corrosion primers, because the chromate ion inhibits rust. As a painting pigment it is cool and lemony with modest tinting strength. The value shown is an approximation. Pigments of this kind are a reminder that a great many colours in the historical record were pushed into existence by industry rather than pulled by painters.
items.funZh: 锶这个元素长期没什么存在感，直到人们发现它在焰火里能烧出鲜艳的红色 —— 所以今天看到烟花里的那抹红，多半是锶的功劳。一个元素在两个领域留下了痕迹：防锈漆和烟花。
items.funEn: Strontium went largely unnoticed as an element until it was found to burn a vivid red in flares and fireworks, which is why the red in a display is usually down to it. One element leaving its mark in two unrelated places: anti-rust primer and pyrotechnics.

items.histZh: 钼红是钼酸铅与铬酸铅的固溶体，20 世纪中期开发出来，主要目的是替代镉红这类更贵的红。它的色相偏暖偏橙，遮盖力强、价格低，在工业涂料里用得很多。缺点是耐光性和耐候性不如镉系，长期户外会褪色。屏幕上的钼红是近似值。
items.histEn: Molybdate red is a solid solution of lead molybdate and lead chromate, developed in the mid-twentieth century largely to replace more expensive reds such as the cadmiums. Warm and orange-leaning, strongly opaque and cheap, it found wide use in industrial coatings. Its weakness is that lightfastness and weather resistance fall short of the cadmiums, and long outdoor exposure fades it. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 钼在颜料里属于「配角元素」—— 它很少自己当主角，但加一点进去能改掉主色颜料的晶型和色相。这类微量添加的调节手段，在 20 世纪的颜料化学里是常规操作，效果比重新设计一种颜料快得多。
items.funEn: Molybdenum plays a supporting role in pigments: it seldom leads, but a small addition alters the crystal form and hue of the principal colourant. This kind of minor-dopant tuning became standard practice in twentieth-century pigment chemistry, being far quicker than designing a new pigment from scratch.

items.histZh: 酞菁青是酞菁蓝里偏绿的那一档。酞菁蓝分「红相」和「绿相」两类，成分相同、晶体形态不同 —— 这一点很关键：同样的分子，排列方式变了，吸收的波长就变，颜色就从偏紫的蓝挪到偏青的蓝。屏幕上的酞菁青是近似值。
items.histEn: Phthalo cyan is the green-leaning grade of phthalo blue. The pigment comes in red-shade and green-shade forms of identical composition but different crystal habit, and that distinction matters: the same molecule, differently arranged, absorbs at different wavelengths, moving the colour from a violet-leaning blue to a cyan-leaning one. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 「同一种分子、不同晶型、两种颜色」在颜料里很常见，酞菁系列是最典型的例子。这也解释了一个实际现象：同一个色名下买到的两管颜料，色相可能不一样 —— 厂商换了个晶型，名字却懒得改。
items.funEn: One molecule, two crystal forms, two colours: phthalocyanines are the standard example, and it explains a practical nuisance. Two tubes bought under the same name may differ in hue because the maker changed crystal form without bothering to change the label.

items.histZh: 祖母绿在颜料里指的是水合氧化铬，1838 年前后问世，是一种透明的深绿，今天常叫「铬翠绿」。它跟巴黎绿不是一回事 —— 巴黎绿含砷，而它不含，所以在 19 世纪含砷绿铺天盖地的时候，它是少数安全的选择之一。屏幕上的祖母绿是近似值，真颜料偏透明发沉。
items.histEn: Emerald green in pigment terms means hydrated chromium oxide, introduced around 1838: a transparent deep green, now usually called viridian. It is not the same thing as Paris green, which contains arsenic and which this does not, so at a time when arsenical greens were everywhere it was one of the few safe options. The value shown is an approximation; the real pigment is darker and more translucent.
items.funZh: 「祖母绿」这个中文名跟宝石重名，所以很容易误会成宝石粉做的颜料 —— 其实完全无关，它是化工厂里做出来的化合物。颜料名借用宝石名的情况不少，基本都只是取「颜色像」的意思。
items.funEn: The Chinese name borrowed from the gemstone invites the assumption that the pigment is ground emerald, which it is not at all: it is a laboratory compound. Pigments borrowing gemstone names is common enough, and the borrowing almost always means only that the colour resembles it.

items.aliasZh: 普鲁士绿 · 不伦瑞克绿
items.histZh: 普鲁士绿严格说不是一种化合物，而是普鲁士蓝与铬黄混合出来的商品颜料，19 世纪很常见，别名「不伦瑞克绿」。它代表了一个转折：在此之前，画家要绿得自己调；从 19 世纪开始，颜料商开始卖调好的混合色，「一管就是那个颜色」逐渐成了常态。屏幕上的普鲁士绿是近似值。
items.histEn: Prussian green is not a compound but a commercial mixture of Prussian blue and chrome yellow, common in the nineteenth century and also known as Brunswick green. It marks a turning point: before it, a painter who wanted green mixed it; from the nineteenth century onward manufacturers sold blended colours ready-made, and a tube being a single fixed hue gradually became the norm. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 混合颜料的稳定性取两个成分里较差的那一个：普鲁士绿里的铬黄见光会变暗，所以整体并不耐久。这也是预混色的通病 —— 只要有一个成分不稳，整管都跟着完蛋。
items.funEn: A blended pigment is only as stable as its weaker component. The chrome yellow in Prussian green darkens in light, and the mixture as a whole therefore does not last. That is the general trouble with pre-mixed colours: one unstable ingredient takes the whole tube down with it.

items.histZh: 青铜粉是把铜锡合金磨成极细的粉末，用来模仿金色 —— 因为它比真金便宜太多。它在中世纪的手抄本、后来的漆器和印刷里都用得上，是「假金」的主要原料。问题在于铜会氧化：时间一长，青铜粉会发暗发绿，所以古书上的「金色」今天常常是褐绿的。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Bronze powder is a copper-tin alloy ground extremely fine, used to imitate gold because it costs far less. It appears in medieval manuscripts and later in lacquer and printing, and it is the main ingredient of fake gold. The trouble is that copper oxidises: over time bronze powder darkens and greens, which is why the gold in old books is so often brown-green today. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 金属颜料跟普通颜料的作用机理完全不同：普通颜料靠吸收，金属粉靠反射 —— 光打到金属片上被反射回来，看起来就像金属本身在发光。所以金属色一旦涂层氧化，反射被打乱，光泽就没了，剩下一个暗褐。
items.funEn: Metallic pigments work on an entirely different principle from ordinary ones. Ordinary pigments absorb; metal flakes reflect, so the light bouncing back makes it look as though the metal itself is glowing. Once the surface oxidises, the reflection is disrupted, the lustre goes, and an unremarkable dark brown is left.

items.histZh: 金粉是把金箔研细后加胶制成的颜料，中国叫「泥金」，欧洲叫「贝壳金」，因为传统上装在贝壳里。它比贴金箔灵活得多，可以直接用笔画线、写字、勾细节。金不氧化，所以泥金画过的地方几百年后仍然是亮的 —— 这也是古画上金线总是最先跳出来的原因。屏幕上的金粉是近似值，真金的反光无法在屏幕上还原。
items.histEn: Gold powder is gold leaf ground fine and bound with a medium — mud gold in Chinese, shell gold in Europe, the latter because it was traditionally kept in a shell. Far more flexible than applied leaf, it can be drawn with a brush into lines, lettering and fine detail. Gold does not oxidise, which is why gilded passages in old paintings still shine after centuries, and why a gold line is usually the first thing to jump out of an old picture. The value shown is an approximation; real gold's reflectance cannot be reproduced on a screen.
items.funZh: 金箔要研成粉有个特殊工序：先把它和蜂蜜或盐一起长时间研磨，防止金片互相粘连，磨好之后再洗掉介质。所以金粉的成本主要不是金，是这一步手工 —— 有时候比金子本身贵。
items.funEn: Grinding gold leaf into powder requires a particular trick: it is milled for a long time together with honey or salt so the flakes do not weld to one another, and the medium is washed out afterwards. The cost of gold powder is therefore mostly labour rather than metal, and sometimes the labour costs more than the gold.

items.histZh: 银粉是把银箔研细做成的颜料，用法跟金粉一样，但命运完全不同：银会氧化硫化，时间一长就发黑或发灰，所以古画上的银线往往比金线狼狈得多。中世纪的手抄本里常见到发黑的银字，那是它本来就不是黑的。屏幕上的银粉是近似值，金属反射同样还原不了。
items.histEn: Silver powder is ground silver leaf used exactly like gold powder, with a completely different fate: silver tarnishes, going black or grey within decades, so silver lines in old paintings are generally in much worse condition than gold ones. Medieval manuscripts often show silver lettering that has gone black having started out anything but. The value shown is an approximation; as with gold, the metallic reflectance cannot be reproduced.
items.funZh: 银比金活泼得多，所以它跟空气里的硫化物反应生成黑色的硫化银 —— 银器变黑就是这个道理。想让它复原并不难：用铝箔和小苏打热水浸泡，铝把电子让给银，黑色就被还原回去了。
items.funEn: Silver is far more reactive than gold and combines with sulfur compounds in air to give black silver sulfide, which is the whole story of tarnished silverware. Reversing it is not hard: a hot bath with aluminium foil and bicarbonate of soda lets the aluminium donate electrons back, and the black lifts.

items.histZh: 铜粉是研细的铜，用来做偏红的金属色，比金粉暖、比银粉有色。它的命运和青铜粉差不多：铜会氧化，时间一长从铜红转成暗褐、再转成绿锈。所以老画上凡是「本来想做成金色」的便宜替代，今天基本都是负面教材。屏幕上的铜粉是近似值。
items.histEn: Copper powder is finely ground copper, used for a reddish metallic tone that is warmer than gold and more coloured than silver. Its fate resembles bronze powder's: copper oxidises, going from a copper red through dark brown to green corrosion. Which is why the cheap substitutes for gold in old paintings are today, almost without exception, cautionary examples. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 铜的氧化是分阶段的：先是表面生成红褐色的氧化亚铜，再进一步变成黑色的氧化铜，最后在有硫或氯的环境里长出绿色的碱式碳酸铜 —— 也就是铜绿。所以一块旧铜器的颜色，其实记录了它经历过的环境。
items.funEn: Copper oxidises in stages: red-brown cuprous oxide first, then black cupric oxide, and finally, given sulfur or chloride, the green basic carbonate known as verdigris. The colour of an old bronze therefore records the environments it has passed through.

items.histZh: 钴黑是氧化钴系的黑色颜料，色相偏冷、带一点蓝，跟炭黑那种暖调黑形成对照。它耐高温、耐酸碱、稳定性极好，所以大量用在陶瓷釉料里，作为黑色发色剂。作为绘画颜料它偏贵、着色力一般，用得不算多。屏幕上的钴黑是近似值。
items.histEn: Cobalt black is a black pigment of the cobalt oxide family, cool and faintly blue in a way that sets it against the warm blacks of the carbon group. Its heat, acid and alkali resistance is excellent, which is why it is used in quantity in ceramic glazes as a black colorant. As a painting pigment it is expensive and only moderately strong, so it is not much used. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 黑颜料是唯一一类「颜色越黑越难做」的颜料：要让物体显得黑，就得让几乎所有可见光都被吸收，这在材料上很不容易。所以真正意义上的「最黑」材料一直是实验室的成果，跟画画没什么关系。
items.funEn: Black is the one colour that gets harder as it gets better: making something look black means absorbing essentially every visible wavelength, which is demanding in materials terms. That is why the genuinely blackest substances have always been laboratory results with little to do with painting.

items.histZh: 铋黄是钒酸铋，20 世纪后期才作为颜料上市，主要动机是环保：它能顶替含铅的铬黄和含镉的镉黄，色相和遮盖力都接近，毒性却低得多。今天它已经大量替代了工业上的铬黄。屏幕上的铋黄是近似值，真颜料比这个略偏绿、更亮。
items.histEn: Bismuth yellow is bismuth vanadate, brought to market only in the later twentieth century, and the motive was environmental: it can stand in for lead-bearing chrome yellow and for cadmium yellow, matching them closely in hue and opacity while being far less toxic. It has already displaced much of the industrial chrome yellow. The value shown is an approximation; the real pigment is slightly greener and brighter.
items.funZh: 铋是一种很少被提起的重金属，日常生活里最常遇到它的地方是胃药 —— 有些胃黏膜保护剂的主要成分就是铋的化合物。所以同一个元素既在胃里也在颜料管里，毒性低是它能两处通吃的原因。
items.funEn: Bismuth is a heavy metal rarely discussed, and the place most people meet it is in stomach medicine: some protective preparations are bismuth compounds. One element in both a stomach and a paint tube, its low toxicity being exactly what allows it to serve in both.
